name: brains-flashcards
description: Prepare a flashcard from a word or expression and review it in Brains.

interface.shortDescription: From a conversation to your memory
interface.longDescription: Turn a word or expression you choose into a contextual flashcard with an optional image. Review and edit the draft, choose an area, and confirm saving in Brains. Nothing is saved by ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Prepare an English flashcard for a word I just learned, with a simple example sentence and a text-free image.

positive.description: Prepare a text-only flashcard after the user explicitly chooses no image.
positive.prompt: Prepare a flashcard without an image. Front: to bet. Back: I don't like to bet. Return the Brains review link and tell me whether it was saved.
positive.expected_behavior: Return one temporary Brains review link with the exact front and back, saved=false, and a 30-minute expiration. Do not claim the card was saved.

positive.description: Prepare a flashcard using an image attached to this ChatGPT conversation.
positive.prompt: Prepare a flashcard for 'to become' with the sentence 'I want to become fluent in English.' Use the attached image as the card image.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the attached image reference with the matching front and back, return a temporary review link, and state that saving must be confirmed in Brains.

positive.description: Prepare three independent flashcards, each paired with its own attached image.
positive.prompt: Prepare three separate Brains flashcards for 'to become — I want to become fluent in English', 'to bet — I don't like to bet', and 'to bite — My son loves to bite his toys'. Use the corresponding attached image for each card and return a separate review link for each.
positive.expected_behavior: Return three separate temporary links, each containing the correct front, back, and matching image reference. All results report saved=false.

positive.description: Keep the generated image associated with its own flashcard draft.
positive.prompt: Create a flashcard for 'need' with the sentence 'I need to put on my shirt.' Use the image I attached for this card and prepare it in Brains.
positive.expected_behavior: Return one review link whose draft contains the requested text and the attached image reference; do not save anything.

positive.description: Allow the user to review and confirm a prepared draft in the Brains app.
positive.prompt: Prepare a flashcard for 'awesome' with the sentence 'That was an awesome performance!' Use the attached image and let me review it in Brains.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a temporary /import/chatgpt review link, explain that the user chooses an area and confirms in Brains, and make no database write.

negative.description: Do not create a card when the user only asks for a translation.
negative.prompt: What does 'to bite' mean in Portuguese?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the translation question without calling prepare_flashcard because the user did not ask to create a card.

negative.description: Do not silently omit an image requested by the user when no image attachment is available.
negative.prompt: Prepare a flashcard for 'to become' with an image, but I have not attached or generated one yet.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask the user to attach or generate the image. Do not set withoutImage=true and do not present a card without the requested image.

negative.description: Do not treat a local path or sandbox URI as an image attachment.
negative.prompt: Prepare a flashcard for 'to bite' and use this image: /mnt/data/brains_flashcards/to_bite.png.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the local path is not accessible to Brains and ask the user to attach the image to the ChatGPT conversation. Never fetch or pass the local path.

review.commerce_description: Brains does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: prepares temporary flashcard drafts with optional ChatGPT image attachments. Users choose an area and confirm saving in Brains.
